Remote GPU jobs (train / eval).

positional arguments:
  {train,run,eval,grpo,serve,search,cleanup,release}
    train               Fine-tune on a rented GPU, pull the adapter, destroy.
    run                 Alias of `train`; `run --smoke` is the no-cost self-
                        test.
    eval                Benchmark model(s) on a rented GPU. No training.
    grpo                GRPO on a rented GPU against the local env service
                        (make rl-serve first); ALWAYS destroys.
    serve               Serve the student on 127.0.0.1:8001 through a tunnel
                        until --for-seconds or Ctrl-C.
    search              Dry run: print the cheapest allowed offer, provision
                        nothing.
    cleanup             Destroy instances abandoned by dead runs (see --all).
    release             Hand a recorded instance over to `cleanup` (writes the
                        pid null sentinel; destroys nothing).

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
